_comment: Who may show the verified badge, and which identifier namespaces each of them owns.
The entry schema has always described `verified` as a 'Mirror of verified-authors.json
membership; set by CI, not self-asserted' — but this file did not exist and no script read
it, so the badge was exactly what the submitter typed. 21 of 25 entries carried it. With the
catalog open to third parties, that is a stranger shipping a verified first-party lookalike
`namespaces` is what makes the check hold in BOTH directions (scripts/validate.py):
an entry under `run.vineyard.*` must be authored by vineyard-run, and an entry claiming to be
authored by vineyard-run must be under one of vineyard-run's namespaces. Without the second
half, `author` is a free string and anyone can wear the name.
Whether an author really controls the DOMAIN behind a namespace is deliberately NOT settled
here — that is a review question. This file is the operator's own record of who was accepted.
Submitters never edit this file. A PR that touches it is a governance change, not a listing.
